why: Officer paid lip service to children's best interests and ran a hardship test.
Officer unreasonably discounted establishment as common, without justifying the finding.
Officer rejected new letters as not new without applying the required new-evidence factors.
Undisclosed extrinsic verification relied on without giving the applicant a chance to respond.
Maximum punishment of the foreign offence, measured for Canadian equivalence under s.36(1)(a).
Manager failed to assess whether the misrepresentation was honestly and reasonably made.
Letters dated after the RPD decision sought admission as new evidence under s.110(4).
